decomposition_rule: Generate only visual assets that cannot reasonably be built as native React/Figma UI.
pilot_note: PILOT SCREEN. Blocked until Faizal (1) uploads the approved Parent Dashboard master design as master-reference.png, (2) uploads eq-master-reference.png and environment style references, (3) reviews and approves this manifest. Nothing generates before that.

native_ui.name: Greeting
native_ui.notes: Text component (personalised salutation). Native text, never an image.

native_ui.name: Headline
native_ui.notes: Text component. Native text, never an image.

native_ui.name: Progress rings
native_ui.notes: SVG/CSS ring components with animated stroke. Never generated as image.

native_ui.name: Streak card
native_ui.notes: Card component: background, radius, shadow via CSS; streak number and label are native text.

native_ui.name: Verify row
native_ui.notes: Native row component with SVG icon and text.

native_ui.name: Family Quest text and button
native_ui.notes: Native text + button component. The button is never part of any generated image.

native_ui.name: Bottom navigation
native_ui.notes: Native nav bar with existing SVG icon set.

generated_assets.name: Dashboard — EQ Greeting Companion
generated_assets.purpose: EQ character in a calm, friendly greeting pose that sits beside the dashboard greeting text and welcomes the parent.
generated_assets.prompt_details: EQ stands facing slightly toward the viewer with one arm raised in a gentle small wave, relaxed posture, soft cheerful expression.

placement.description: To the right of the greeting and headline text block, bottom-aligned with the header section.

generated_assets.alignment: right edge of header content, baseline-aligned with headline
generated_assets.responsive: Scales down to 96px width on small screens; hide below 320px viewport rather than shrinking further.

generated_assets.name: Dashboard — Hero Landscape
generated_assets.purpose: Serene Islamic-inspired environment illustration used as the hero backdrop band of the dashboard: soft rolling hills, distant mosque silhouette with dome and minaret, warm sky, gentle clouds.
generated_assets.prompt_details: Wide tranquil landscape, dawn light, soft gradient sky, distant elegant mosque silhouette, rolling green hills, a few stylised trees, no people, no animals.

placement.description: Full-width band directly under the header greeting area, behind no interactive elements; progress rings sit below it, not on top of it.

generated_assets.responsive: Full-bleed at all widths; crop vertically from center; keep the mosque silhouette within the safe middle 60% so it survives cropping.

generated_assets.name: Dashboard — Family Quest Floating Island
generated_assets.purpose: A small floating island illustration for the Family Quest card: a chunk of land floating in air with grass, a tiny tree and subtle floating rocks, evoking a family adventure destination.
generated_assets.prompt_details: Compact floating island viewed slightly from below, lush grass top, earthy underside tapering to a point, one small stylised tree, two tiny floating rock fragments nearby, soft magical ambience.

placement.description: Right side of the Family Quest card, vertically centered; quest text and button sit to its left as native components.

generated_assets.alignment: right-aligned inside the card with 16px inset
generated_assets.responsive: Scales with card height; minimum 72px rendered width; never overlaps the native button.
